ph.zh: 无量纲。水土比常见 1:2.5 或 1:1，看单子注明，别跨实验室硬比。
ph.en: Dimensionless. Soil:water is often 1:2.5 or 1:1 — read the note, don’t mix labs.

ec.zh: 常见 mS/cm 或 dS/m，也有 μS/cm。水土比不同，数字不能直接抄邻县。
ec.en: Often mS/cm or dS/m, sometimes μS/cm. Different soil:water ratios are not the same number.

salt.zh: 常见 g/kg 或 %。和 EC 一起看咸。
salt.en: Often g/kg or %. Read with EC.

om.zh: 常见 g/kg。有的实验室写 %。

texture.zh: 沙 / 壤 / 黏，或卡氏三角的名称。不是一个公斤数。
texture.en: Sand / loam / clay, or a texture-triangle name — not a kg figure.

cec.zh: 常见 cmol/kg 或 cmol(+) / kg。

aggregate.zh: 多为描述或稳定性分级，不是处方袋数。
aggregate.en: Usually a description or stability class.

fc.zh: 常用 % 或 g/g。过了这条线就是涝。
fc.en: Usually % or g/g. Past the line is waterlog.

n.zh: 全氮常见 g/kg。别和碱解氮混成一格。
n.en: Total N often g/kg. Don’t mix it with available N.

alkn.zh: 常见 mg/kg。这是当季能用的氮，不是库里全部。
alkn.en: Often mg/kg. This season’s N, not the whole warehouse.

p.zh: 全磷常见 g/kg。有效磷才是根能摸到的。
p.en: Total P often g/kg. Available P is what the root can touch.

avp.zh: 常见 mg/kg。方法（Olsen 等）写在单子上。
avp.en: Often mg/kg. The method (Olsen etc.) is on the sheet.

b.zh: 有效硼常见 mg/kg。缺和毒只隔一层纸。
b.en: Available B often mg/kg. Deficiency and toxicity are close.

mo.zh: 有效钼常见 mg/kg。微量，加倍会出事。
mo.en: Available Mo often mg/kg. A trace — doubling hurts.

al.zh: 交换性铝常见 cmol/kg。pH 低了它才活跃。
al.en: Exchangeable Al often cmol/kg. It wakes up when pH is low.

na.zh: 交换性钠常见 cmol/kg；碱化度 ESP 常用 %。
na.en: Exchangeable Na often cmol/kg; ESP is usually %.

bulk.zh: 常见 g/cm³。耕层过大说明紧。
bulk.en: Often g/cm³. High in the tilled layer means tight.

test.zh: 配方本身没有单位。先看取样深度和水土比。
test.en: The recipe has no unit. Read sampling depth and the soil:water ratio first.

acid.zh: 酸化是判断，不是单子上的一格。对着 pH 和交换性铝看。
acid.en: Acidification is a reading, not one cell. Pair pH and exchangeable Al.

saline.zh: 盐碱是判断。咸看 EC/全盐，涩看 pH 和钠。
saline.en: A reading: salt is EC; alkali is pH and sodium.

compaction.zh: 对着容重、孔隙和刨坑看，不是一袋肥的单位。
compaction.en: Read bulk density, pores and a dug pit — not a bag of fertiliser.

gley.zh: 潜育是判断。对着渍水和青灰色看。
gley.en: A reading: standing water and blue-grey soil.

replant.zh: 连作是判断。菌剂没有标准单位能替代轮作。
replant.en: A reading. A microbe bag has no unit that replaces rotation.
